prompts: What's due today in Todoist, and what should I do first?
Turn these meeting notes into tasks in my Work project.
requirements: A Todoist account with access to the projects you want to use.
limitations: Project sharing and workspace roles limit what this connection can read or change.
Todoist's MCP server asks for read and write access, so Todoist may refuse some deletions.
This app does not start automatic monitoring from its MCP connection alone.
